proof_audit.audit: Induction gives H_sj(b)=H_sj(0)+b only for a timely unrestricted nonmaturing costless cash injection that changes no other flow or policy. A violated prefix proves necessity. At each bucket all legitimate receipts precede payments, no receipt requires an omitted payment and no earlier deadline is omitted; therefore nonnegative cutoff closes also ensure individual payments can settle. Finite scenario/date set makes the maximum attained. Equality and all-nonnegative zero case are explicit. This is neither a probability guarantee nor an optimal-cost result.

Positive price and haircut<1 ensure advance per unit>0. Peer uses bounds and complementarity: after dividing by a nonzero offer fraction, the initial draw is bounded by target and capacity and one binds; after maintenance, retained principal is bounded by original principal and revised capacity and one binds. Pledged units times advance equal principal, free units remain nonnegative, and the four collateral pools conserve owned units. Interest follows opening principal for each completed interval; later release cannot prefinance its own principal repayment.

Every exact journal event must match its contractual account vector. Principal receipt/paydown, deposit/other-liability settlement and margin posting/return have no income entry; customer-line disbursement creates a loan; already-accrued old interest reduces cash/payable; new interest accrual reduces equity and increases payable before later payment; cash variation changes equity under the reset-to-zero derivative convention. Every event and cutoff reconciles, including negative-cash full-payment diagnostics explicitly labeled infeasible.

Finite annuity sums are independently evaluated using the geometric closed form and its differentiated quotient. Zero yield uses the removable-limit formula P=face+n*coupon and Pprime=-n*face-coupon*n(n+1)/2. The floating identity couples resetting coupons to the same discount curve and telescopes without dividing by yield. Distinct EVE and first-year NII changes follow from fixed-liability duration versus floating funding coupons. Negative floating coupons are permitted by the explicit no-floor assumption.

limitations: Another machine-assisted evidence/calculation review, not independent human academic certification.
The synthetic finite scenario set has no probabilities, calibrated behavior or empirical control/funding-access evidence.
The cash/equity reserve certificate needs the stated fixed policy, receipt order, timely resources and nonmaturing funding. Negative-cash rows are diagnostic, not an executable default resolution.
Principal-only collateral tests, blocked units, margin segregation and returns, loan performance and reset-derivative book entries are stipulated conventions, not universal legal or accounting rules.
The marked-equity proxy values other accounts at book. The ALM flat-curve/no-spread/no-floor reset family is bounded. Neither values all bank optionality, credit, behavioral or intraday risks.
